info.name: True Fit - Consumer Fit Recommendation API
Get a Fit Recommendation for the given styles.

params.name: locale
params.description: Identifier specifying the locale to use when retrieving suggested brands or any type of sizes e.g. sizes, bra sizes, inseams or sleeve lengths. This attribute is only required when the store supports multiple locales. Use an ISO 639 language code followed by an ISO 3166 country code, e.g. en_US.

params.name: integrationPlatform
params.description: Specifies whether the call is being made from inside the context of an app or the web.

params.name: s
params.description: Store Style IDs to request Fit Recommendations for.

items.docs: Get a Fit Recommendation for the given styles.
